data.title: 角楯花凛 · 战术更衣室的受赞红晕
data.description: 射击训练后空无一人的特勤更衣室内，昏黄的壁灯映照着排排铁柜。花凛靠在柜门前，额前微带细汗，小麦色的肌肤泛着健康的红润光泽。近距离面对老师直接而专注的深情凝视，她的心跳如擂鼓般骤升，金眸轻颤，娇羞得几乎无法呼吸。
data.location: dim tactical locker room in front of metal lockers
data.action: leaning back against lockers, heavy blush, bead of sweat, breathtaking close distance
data.lighting: warm amber overhead lighting accentuating toned collarbone and facial blush
data.mood: intense pounding heartbeat and melting shyness
data.promptProse: Backed softly against a metal locker in dim evening light, Kakudate Karin looks up with intense golden eyes and heavily flushed tanned cheeks in breathless romantic proximity.
data.animaCaption: Karin blushing heavily against the locker in close proximity.
